alignment: Center each model on the torso island's bounding-box midpoint in XY and 0.60m above its floor.
selection: Weld positions to 10 micrometres for island membership. Preserve evaluated positions and per-corner normals. #4 and #16 have an open face front. Retain the real hair-backed shell. Remove #16's cap and bill by its blue/grey atlas UV islands. An uncovered opening remains where the artist supplied no second skin beneath the cap. #20, #22, #25, #93 have an integrated skin/ear shell. Clothing and tails are excluded; each part is enumerated below.
